easy.q: How many events make up an Olympic decathlon?
easy.fact: The events are spread over two days of competition.

easy.q: How many squares make up each piece in Tetris?
easy.fact: Tetris was created by Soviet engineer Alexey Pajitnov in 1984.

easy.q: How many U.S. state names include the word North or South?
easy.fact: The Carolinas split in 1712; the Dakotas both joined the Union in 1889.

easy.q: Ancient Rome was famously built on how many hills?
easy.fact: The Palatine Hill is where Rome's emperors built their palaces.

easy.q: How many Angels work for Charlie in the original Charlie's Angels TV series?
easy.fact: Charlie himself was only ever heard, never fully seen.

medium.q: In what year did Snapchat launch?
medium.fact: It first launched under the name Picaboo.

medium.q: How many feet wide is an NHL goal?
To the nearest mile, how long is Michigan's Mackinac Bridge?
medium.fact: It links Michigan's Upper and Lower peninsulas and opened in 1957.

medium.q: How many countries founded NATO in 1949?
medium.fact: The treaty was signed in Washington, D.C., on April 4, 1949.

medium.q: How many tiles are in a standard double-six set of dominoes?
medium.fact: Each possible pairing of zero through six appears exactly once.

hard.q: How tall is Paris's Arc de Triomphe, to the nearest foot?
hard.fact: The Tomb of the Unknown Soldier lies beneath it.

hard.q: Rocky Marciano retired as heavyweight champion with a perfect record. How many pro fights did he win?
hard.fact: He won 43 of those fights by knockout.

hard.q: To the nearest hundred miles, how long was the Oregon Trail?
hard.fact: Wagon trains usually took four to six months to make the trip.

hard.q: How many Oscar nominations did Everything Everywhere All at Once receive?
hard.fact: It won seven, including Best Picture.
